Replace every one of them with generated artwork; the shot list for that is in the effort notes and the contract is in CLAUDE.md.

schema.note: Version 2 adds provenance, so that a generated sheet can be traced back to the call that made it without the raw generation being in the repository (art/ is gitignored and stays that way). `placeholders` holds the mechanical crops and is rewritten wholesale by scripts/make-actor-placeholders.mjs; `cycles` holds generated Cycle sheets and is written by the asset builder. Both arrays use the same entry shape. Delete this file when the last placeholder is gone.

entry.frames: Frame count, matching the `.cycle` layer's data-frames in index.html.
entry.columns: Grid columns, matching data-columns. Frames run left to right then top to bottom.
entry.frameWidth: 192 for the Boy and the Girl, 256 for the cats.
entry.frameHeight: 320 for the Boy and the Girl, 192 for the cats.
entry.source: Where the pixels came from. For a generated sheet, the raw generation's path under the effort's art/ directory plus its sha256; for a placeholder, the Character Sheet object it was cropped out of.
entry.generator: The tool and model that made the raw generation, e.g. `codex image_gen`. Absent, or the script's own path, when nothing generated anything.
entry.prompt: Path to the prompt file in the effort directory, so the exact call can be read back.
entry.references: The Character Sheets the generation was anchored on: `[{ file, sha256 }]`. Identity comes from art/characters/v1 and never from another generated asset.
entry.builtBy: The script that turned the raw generation into this sheet, with its version: `scripts/<name>.mjs@<version>`.
entry.validatedAt: ISO date on which `node scripts/check-assets.mjs` last passed this file. The validator is the mechanical half of acceptance; the owner's taste gate is the other half.
